no_hit_definition: Physical page 1..page_count with no hit under any frozen discovery query applicable to that document, using all_query_hits.jsonl rather than only selected leads.
ranking: SHA-256 of FG3-NEGATIVE-FRAME-20260924-v1|document_id|physical_page, ascending hexadecimal; break ties by physical page
selection: First four no-hit pages per document, or all when fewer than four.
human_question: Does this no-hit page contain a Panel A, B, or C target phenomenon missed by the cue queries?
use: Frame diagnostic only; no primary model evaluation, no quota filling, no discovery reopening, no estimate of corpus-wide recall.
